changeLog.change: Initial ruleset. Cap £751 (GB). Northern Ireland differs (£783) and is not yet modelled.

notes: The first £30,000 of genuine redundancy pay is tax free. The excess is taxed at your marginal income tax rate.
Notice pay (including PILON) and holiday pay are taxed as normal earnings with National Insurance.
A large payout can push part of the excess into a higher band. Confirm with GOV.UK or a tax adviser.
You need 2 full years of service to qualify for statutory redundancy pay.
Weekly pay is capped at £751 in England, Scotland and Wales. Northern Ireland uses a different cap.
Redundancy pay up to £30,000 is tax free. Notice and holiday pay are taxed normally.
Your contract may provide more than the legal minimum. Check it.
Notice: 1 week after a month of service, then 1 week per year, capped at 12 weeks.

checklist.text: Get the decision in writing: reason, selection process, final date, and what you will be paid.
Don't sign a settlement agreement on the spot. You are entitled to independent legal advice, usually at your employer's expense.
Save your contract, payslips, and any redundancy policy or consultation documents.
Check the package covers redundancy pay, notice pay, and all unused holiday.
Run your numbers here, then confirm them with the GOV.UK calculator.
If selection seemed unfair or consultation did not happen, contact Acas now. Tribunal claims close about 3 months after dismissal.
Apply for Universal Credit and New Style JSA today. Claims take weeks to start paying.
Check your workplace pension and any life cover linked to it.
Work out your budget runway: payout plus savings, divided by monthly essentials.
If money is tight, get free debt advice early. StepChange, National Debtline and Citizens Advice are all free.
Update your CV and LinkedIn. Redundancy is about the role, not your performance.
With 2+ years of service you are entitled to reasonable paid time off to look for work or arrange training.

glossary.definition: The legal minimum after 2 years' service: half a week's pay per year under 22, one week per year from 22 to 40, one and a half weeks per year from 41. Capped at 20 years and £751 a week.
Anything above the statutory minimum, set by your contract or policy. Many employers pay more than the legal floor.
One week after a month of service, rising by one week per full year, up to 12 weeks. Your contract may provide more.
A binding agreement in which you waive claims in exchange for payment. Only valid once you have had independent legal advice, which the employer usually funds.
Your employer must consult you before making you redundant. Proposing 20 or more redundancies triggers collective consultation rules with minimum timeframes.
Dismissal without a fair reason or fair process. A redundancy that is not genuine can qualify. Claims generally must start within 3 months, via Acas first.
Serving your notice period at home. Still employed and paid, but not working.
A lump sum instead of working your notice. Taxed as normal pay.
The main means-tested benefit. A redundancy payout counts toward your savings, which can reduce what you receive.
Up to 6 months of support based on your National Insurance record. Not means-tested against savings, so worth claiming even with a payout.
Free, impartial help with workplace disputes. Early conciliation through Acas is the required first step before most tribunal claims.
Genuine redundancy payments are tax free up to £30,000. Notice and holiday pay are taxed as usual.
